recommendation: Keep the source fix. It removes the stale wording that directly matched FHIR-7567 while preserving later Security WG Provenance positioning; no further core work is needed unless the work group reopens broader W3C alignment questions.
issue_request: FHIR-7567 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification Security issue for FHIR-core Provenance. It challenged overstated W3C PROV alignment language, the entity-role mapping semantics, and the absence or unclear representation of a named activity comparable to Act.code; the final Jira resolution said the issue was resolved through other change proposals with nothing more to resolve.
initial_application: No relevant source commit explicitly named FHIR-7567. Other Provenance CPs added or refined the activity/reason area noted in Jira comments, and the current active Provenance StructureDefinition includes Provenance.activity, why/authorization elements, and Provenance.entity.role mapped to W3C Entity.role. The old W3C PROV mapping preamble in source/mappingSpaces.xml, introduced before the issue by 0b3734f9dc, remained unchanged and still contained the overclaim quoted by the issue.
additional_context: Provenance is active in source/fhir.ini, and source/mappingSpaces.xml publishes the W3C PROV mapping-space preamble used for Provenance mappings. Current Provenance narrative already narrows the relationship to W3C by saying the resource is tailored to FHIR use cases and distinguishes Provenance generation from AuditEvent usage. Related combined-branch reconciliation commits already cover FHIR-7750, FHIR-23065, and FHIR-55410, so this seed needed only the remaining mapping-space correction.
reconciliation: Changed source/mappingSpaces.xml to say the Provenance model is informed by W3C Provenance, tailored to FHIR use cases, and that mappings identify corresponding W3C PROV concepts where appropriate rather than asserting a lossless PROV-O transformation for every FHIR Provenance detail.
source_changes: source/mappingSpaces.xml: narrowed the W3C PROV mapping preamble for Provenance to remove the all-parts-formally-mapped/lossless-transformation claim.
